The resolve stage auto-resolves the most-recent order (NL→id) and flags autoResolvedMoneyRef; the adopter confirm-on-autoresolve guard parks the RESOLVED envelope and returns REQUEST_CONFIRMATION so a wrong guess can never auto-execute (live-verified D-014). The parked payload carries the resolved order id — templated, never a raw Medusa id (ULIDs are seed-nondeterministic, plan v2 ledger #15).
